name: power-design
description: Decks and websites that do not look AI-made. Brand DNA (extracted live from any URL via Firecrawl, or picked from 74 pre-built brand systems) combined with codified design principles - 20 research-backed rules for slides and 20 for the web, with numeric thresholds. This fork adds a house style guard on generated copy, motion routed to GSAP and The Motion Index with timings reconciled against Material 3, a stated positioning boundary, a distilled build stack reference, and Pro Marketing client brand systems.
